about_short_description.short_description: Protectt.ai provides real-time fraud detection, cyber security, application security testing, risk assessment, and banking services.

product.name: Real-Time Fraud Detection
product.description: Technology that monitors transactions and digital activity in real time to identify and help prevent fraudulent behavior across financial and online environments.

product.name: Cybersecurity Services
product.description: Security services designed to identify, monitor, and help mitigate cyber threats affecting organizational systems, applications, networks, and data.

product.name: Application Security Testing
product.description: Testing services that evaluate applications for vulnerabilities and security weaknesses before or during deployment.

product.name: Risk Assessment
product.description: Assessment services that identify, analyze, and help prioritize security, fraud, and operational risks affecting an organization or its digital services.

product.name: Banking Services
product.description: Banking-related services supporting financial institutions or banking operations, potentially including digital banking and transaction-security capabilities.
